profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer passionate about mobile technology. I've been part of several development teams following agile methodologies. I have experience developing educational apps and e-commerce solutions for companies across Mexico, USA and Canada

My areas of expertise:

- iOS development (Objective-C, Swift)
- Java 
- Mobile architectures

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Microsoft Teams - Mobile developer (Objective-C / Swift)
- Microsoft Teams - Web/Front end engineer (Typescript, Node, React, GraphQL)

positions.title: iOS software engineer
positions.description: Developing iOS Apps in an agile environment for companies in Canada and US. Currently working with MVVM architectures, TDD and UI development.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Design and development of iOS Apps as part of the MTS global team. As part of the development team I'm taking part in several mobile projects dedicated to supporting Herbalife worldwide operations (involving customers, suppliers and distributors).

Most recent app:

- Bizworks

   https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/herbalife-bizworks-mobile/id1042080158?mt=8

- Herbalife POS

   https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/herbalife-pos/id1154285940?mt=8

positions.title: Software development engineer (iOS developer)
positions.description:
